**Other abilities**

* High ownership, resilience, and proactive approach to execution and follow-through.

* Collaborative team player with the ability to work in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

* Able to manage peak periods and support activities beyond standard office hours when required .

description:
**[What the role is]**

Sustainability is integral to Singapore’s long-term growth strategy and economic resilience. Yet, we are operating in a more challenging global environment today. This means governments and businesses have to be more nimble and be prepared to continue to take action in response to climate-related risks and opportunities.
  

* Issues such as rising business costs and supply chain disruptions are top of mind for policymakers and corporate leaders and recent events are exacerbating these challenges.

  
Against this backdrop, the MAS Sustainability Group plays an important role to support FIs in enabling the regional low carbon transition needs:
  
i) Energy Transition – supporting financing solutions that enable Asia’s shift towards lower-carbon energy systems in a manner that enhances energy security, access and affordability
  
ii) Adaptation and Resilience – support mobilisation of capital for regional climate- and nature-related resilience needs.
  
iii) Carbon markets – support FIs to build capabilities and participate across the value chain - from project financing and risk mitigation to trading of credits.
  
  
You will be a member of a central team responsible for the ideation and implementation of sustainability strategies to support our above objectives, working closely with relevant departments within the organisation to anchor Singapore as a leading sustainable and resilience finance centre.

**[What you will be working on]**

In this role, you will:

* Support the Sustainability Group (SG) in key projects aimed at catalysing financing for Asia’s low-carbon transition. Some examples of projects that could be assigned to you are indicated below with the actual portfolio of work determined upon joining.

  + Carbon Markets . This includes collaborating with other government agencies to develop whole-of-economy strategies to grow Singapore as a carbon services and trading hub, and strategies for the Singapore financial sector to capture opportunities arising from Singapore and regional carbon markets.
  + Adaption / Nature Financing . The work involves collaborating with industry and other government agencies to scale up regional adaptation and resilience financing for sectors of focus for ASEAN e.g. agriculture, forestry, infrastructure and other nature-based solutions.
  + Taxonomy . Work includes developing strategies to support Singapore-based financial institutions, corporates and Singapore government agencies to adopt the taxonomy and scale up green and transition finance, develop criteria for environmental objectives and explore initiating interoperability across jurisdictions.

* Support on account management on entities that MAS has key relationships with. This includes support on brief inputs for strategic meetings, assessments of KPIs and administrative processing of grants during annual reviews.
* Participate in cross-divisional working groups where relevant, including on initiatives such as assessment of the state of Singapore’s sustainable finance ecosystem and market, the development of MAS Sustainability Report, and convening of international experts through Advisory Panels.

**[What we are looking for]**

* Relevant work experience in the financial sector is preferred.
* Knowledge of carbon markets, adaptation and resilience, taxonomies is an advantage.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to write clearly and synthesise messages
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to positively influence internal and external stakeholders
* Strong project management skills and able to lead organization-wide projects involving multiple stakeholders
* A good team player who is proactive and motivated

As part of the shortlisting process for this role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and/or undergo further assessment. This is a 2-year contract. All applicants will be notified on whether they are shortlisted or not within 4 weeks of the closing date of this job posting.

This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.

### **Description and Requirements**

**Summary :** This role is the dedicated domain specialist sales for Lenovo's Asset Recovery Service and LCR portfolio across CENTRAL ASIA PACIFIC (CAP) and ANZ. Based in Singapore, you will own the full revenue lifecycle — pipeline origination, enterprise deal pursuit, commercial structuring, contract closure, and disciplined account farming for expansion — across both regions.

You will operate as a trusted sustainability advisor to CIOs, CFOs, and Chief Sustainability Officers across public sector, manufacturing, healthcare, and technology (GSI/CSP) verticals, positioning Lenovo's circular IT solutions as strategic business value — not just a disposal service.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Sales Leadership & Revenue Ownership**

* Own and grow the ARS/LCR revenue target across CENTRAL ASIA PACIFIC (CAP) and ANZ, delivering consistent quarter-on-quarter pipeline growth with 3× coverage discipline.
* Lead the full end-to-end sales motion: prospecting, discovery, solution architecture, commercial structuring, proposals/presentations, and contract closure.
* Develop distinct territory plans for CENTRAL ASIA PACIFIC (CAP) and ANZ that reflect regulatory, cultural, and procurement differences across markets.
* Strong relationship with large GSIs, global large enterprises and working experience
* Drive RFP/RFQ/tender responses for government and enterprise ITAD program across Singapore public sector (GovTech, statutory boards, ministries) and Australian government (NTCRS-obligated enterprises, federal and state agencies).
* Partner with Lenovo 360 channel and distribution ecosystem to co-sell ARS/LCR, extending market reach beyond direct enterprise accounts.

**ARS & LCR Portfolio Selling**

* Cost recovery (residual value realization), compliance (certified data sanitization and regulatory alignment), and ESG impact (Circular Economy Statement reporting). Position and close Lenovo ARS across three value dimensions:
* Structure LCR refresh engagements that bundle ARS collection, Certified Refurbishment options, and Prepaid ARS Credits to help clients plan IT circularity in advance.
* Lead TruScale Device as a Service (DaaS) for Sustainability as the as-a-service anchor — eliminating over-provisioning and embedding structured end-of-life into device procurement cycles.
* Drive adoption of the Intelligent Asset Manager within Lenovo Service Connect, replacing manual ITAD spreadsheets with real-time asset visibility and compliance dashboards.

**Sustainability Advisory & ESG Positioning**

* Serve as a credible sustainability advisor to client C-suite, translating Scope 3 IT emissions reduction, e-waste governance, and circular IT KPIs into commercially relevant narratives.
* Asset baseline assessments, ITAD governance frameworks, NGO device donation program, and measurable ESG impact reporting. Develop Sustainable IT roadmaps as commercial entry points:
* Align Lenovo ARS/LCR to clients' ESG commitments, Scope 3 reporting obligations, Singapore Green Plan and Australia's Net Zero targets.
Position CO₂ Offset Services and Lenovo's LISSA (Intelligent Sustainability Solutions Advisor) as quantified sustainability credentials within refresh and procurement cycles.  

  

**Account Management & Expansion**

* Farm and expand strategic accounts post-close — identifying adjacent device lifecycle, refresh, and managed services opportunities within the installed estate.
* Manage QBRs, executive reporting, and CSAT governance to ensure high retention, reference-ability, and upsell progression.
* Build trusted advisor relationships with IT procurement leaders, sustainability officers, and facilities management stakeholders across both regions.

**Essential Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.
* A sustainability, ESG, or circular economy certification is strong differentiator and actively welcomed.
* 12+ years of B2B technology sales with a proven track record of revenue growth in services, solutions, or managed services environments.
* Able to articulate business value across data security, compliance, cost recovery, and ESG dimensions. Demonstrated experience in ITAD, IT asset lifecycle, or circular economy sales
* Comprehensive understanding of end-to-end security practices, with hands-on experience in security software and solutions like Blanco and Microsoft Intune.
* Proven hunter/farmer sales capability, with experience closing complex multi-stakeholder enterprise deals including formal RFP/RFQ/tender processes.
* Strong CENTRAL ASIA PACIFIC (CAP) market knowledge with established enterprise relationships across banking, public sector, manufacturing, or healthcare.
* Strong relationship with large GSIs, global large enterprises and working experience
* Awareness of Australian e-waste regulation (NTCRS) or prior ANZ client exposure is a distinct advantage. Understanding of the ANZ enterprise IT and sustainability landscape
* Scope 3 IT emissions, e-waste governance, ESG reporting, and circular economy frameworks. Commercially credible sustainability knowledge:
* device provisioning, refresh cycles, DaaS models, Intune/Autopilot. End User Computing (EUC) lifecycle experience and Data Center/Infrastructure devices experience.
